verses.text: Di revelation of Jesus Christ, wey God give am, to show im servants wetin must happen soon; and e send and make am known by im angel to im servant John,
wey bear witness to God word and to di testimony of Jesus Christ, even to all wetin e see.
Blessed be di one wey read, and dem wey hear di words of di prophecy, and keep wetin dem write inside am, for di time dey near.
John to di seven churches wey dey Asia: Grace to una and peace, from di one wey dey, and wey don dey, and wey dey come; and from di seven Spirits wey dey before im throne;
and from Jesus Christ, di faithful witness, di firstborn of di dead, and di ruler of di kings of di earth. To am wey love us, and wash us from our sins by im blood,
and make us a kingdom, priests to im God and Papa; to am be glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
Look, e dey come with di clouds, and every eye go see am, even dem wey pierce am; and all di tribes of di earth go mourn because of am. Even so, Amen.
“I na di Alpha and di Omega,” talk di Lord God, “wey dey, and wey don dey, and wey dey come, di Almighty.”
I, John, una brother and partner with una for di suffering and di kingdom and di patience wey dey inside Jesus, dey di island wey dem dey call Patmos, because of God word and di testimony of Jesus.
I dey inside di Spirit for di Lord day, and I hear one loud voice behind me, like trumpet,
wey talk say, “Wetin you see, write am inside book and send am to di seven churches: to Ephesus, to Smyrna, to Pergamum, to Thyatira, to Sardis, to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
I turn to see di voice wey dey talk with me. When I turn, I see seven golden lampstands;
and for di middle of di lampstands, one like Son of Man, wey wear garment wey reach im feet, and gold belt tie round im chest.
Im head and im hair white like white wool, like snow; im eyes like flame of fire;
im feet like fine brass, as e burn inside furnace; and im voice like di sound of many waters.
For im right hand e get seven stars. Out of im mouth, one sharp two-edged sword dey come out; and im face like di sun wey dey shine for im strength.
When I see am, I fall for im feet like dead man. E put im right hand on me, talk say, “No fear! I na di first and di last,
and di Living One. I die, and look, I dey alive forever and ever. Amen. I get di keys of death and of Hades.
Write di things wey you don see, di things wey dey now, and di things wey go happen after dis.
Di mystery of di seven stars wey you see for my right hand, and di seven golden lampstands: di seven stars na di angels of di seven churches, and di seven lampstands na di seven churches.”
To di angel of di church for Ephesus write: Dis na wetin di one wey hold di seven stars for im right hand talk, di one wey dey walk among di seven golden lampstands:
I know your works, your labour, and your patience, and say you no fit bear evil people, and you don test dem wey talk say dem na apostles and dem no be, and you find say dem na liars.
You get patience and you don bear for my name sake, and you no tire.
But I get dis against you, say you don leave your first love.
So remember wia you fall from, repent and do di first works; or else I go come to you quickly and remove your lampstand from im place, except you repent.
But you get dis one, say you hate di works of di Nicolaitans, wey I also hate.
Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches. To di one wey overcome, I go give am to chop from di tree of life, wey dey inside God paradise.
To di angel of di church for Smyrna write: Dis na wetin di First and di Last talk, wey die and come alive again:
I know your suffering and your poverty, but you rich, and di slander of dem wey talk say dem na Jews and dem no be, but dem na synagogue of Satan.

No fear di things wey you go suffer. Look, di devil go throw some of una enter prison, so that una go dey tested, and una go get suffering for ten days. Dey faithful until death, and I go give you di crown of life.
Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches. Di one wey overcome no go suffer di second death at all.
To di angel of di church for Pergamum write: Dis na wetin di one wey get di sharp two-edged sword talk:
I know wia you dey live, even wia Satan throne dey. You hold my name strong, and you no deny my faith, even for di days of Antipas my faithful witness, wey dem kill among una, wia Satan dey live.

But I get few things against you, say you get some wey hold di teaching of Balaam, wey teach Balak to throw stumbling block before Israel pikin dem, to chop things wey dem sacrifice to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
So you also get some wey hold di teaching of di Nicolaitans in di same way.
Repent therefore, or else I go come to you quickly, and I go fight dem with di sword of my mouth.

Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches. To di one wey overcome, I go give some of di hidden manna, and I go give am white stone, and for di stone dem don write new name wey nobody know except di one wey receive am.
To di angel of di church for Thyatira write: Dis na wetin God Pikin talk, wey im eyes like flame of fire, and im feet like fine brass:
I know your works, your love, faith, service and patience, and say your last works pass di first.

But I get dis against you, say you allow di woman Jezebel, wey talk say e na prophetess; e dey teach and dey deceive my servants to commit sexual immorality and to chop things wey dem sacrifice to idols.
I give am time to repent, and e no wan repent of im sexual immorality.
Look, I go throw am enter sick bed, and dem wey dey commit adultery with am enter great suffering, except dem repent of im works.
I go kill im pikin dem with death, and all di churches go know say na me be di one wey search minds and hearts; and I go give each one of una according to your works.
But to una I talk, to di rest wey dey Thyatira, as many as no get dis teaching, wey no know “di deep things of Satan,” as dem dey call am, I put no other burden on una.
Nevertheless hold strong wetin una get until I come.
Di one wey overcome, and wey keep my works to di end, to am I go give authority over di nations:
e go rule dem with iron rod, as clay pots dem dey break to pieces, as I also don receive from my Papa;
and I go give am di morning star.
Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches.
To di angel of di church for Sardis write: Dis na wetin di one wey get di seven Spirits of God and di seven stars talk: I know your works, say you get name say you dey alive, but you don die.
Wake up, and strengthen di things wey remain, wey dey near to die; for I never find your works complete before my God.
So remember how you receive and hear; keep am, and repent. If therefore you no wake up, I go come like thief, and you no go know wetin hour I go come on you.
But you get few names for Sardis wey no stain dem clothes, and dem go walk with me in white, for dem worthy.
Di one wey overcome go dress in white clothes like dis, and I no go ever blot out im name from di book of life, but I go confess im name before my Papa and before im angels.
Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches.
To di angel of di church for Philadelphia write: Dis na wetin di holy one, di true one, talk, wey get di key of David, wey open and nobody go shut, and shut and nobody dey open:
I know your works. Look, I don set before you one open door, wey nobody fit shut. I know say you get small power, and you don keep my word, and you no deny my name.
Look, I go make some of Satan synagogue, dem wey talk say dem na Jews and dem no be, but dey lie, look, I go make dem come and worship before your feet, and know say I don love you.
Because you don keep di word of my patience, I also go keep you from di hour of testing, wey go come on di whole world, to test dem wey dey dwell on di earth.
I dey come quickly! Hold strong wetin you get, so that nobody go take your crown.

Di one wey overcome, I go make am pillar inside my God temple, and e no go go out again; and I go write on am di name of my God, and di name of di city of my God, di new Jerusalem, wey dey come down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches.
To di angel of di church for Laodicea write: Dis na wetin di Amen talk, di faithful and true witness, di beginning of God creation:
I know your works, say you no cold and you no hot. I for wish say you cold or hot.
So because you dey lukewarm, and you no hot or cold, I go vomit you out of my mouth.
Because you talk say, “I dey rich, and I don get plenty things, and I no need anything,” and you no know say you wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked,

I advise you make you buy gold from me wey dem don refine inside fire, so that you go rich, and white clothes, so that you go dress and di shame of your nakedness no go show; and eye medicine to rub for your eyes, so that you go see.
As many as I love, I dey rebuke and discipline. So make you dey serious and repent.
Look, I dey stand for di door and dey knock. If anybody hear my voice and open di door, I go enter come in to am, and go chop with am, and e go chop with me.
Di one wey overcome, I go give am to sit with me inside my throne, as I also overcome and sit down with my Papa inside im throne.
Anybody wey get ear, make e hear wetin di Spirit dey talk to di churches.

After dis things I look, and look, one door open inside heaven, and di first voice wey I hear, like trumpet wey dey talk with me, talk say, “Come up here, and I go show you things wey must happen after dis.”
Immediately I dey inside di Spirit, and look, one throne dey set inside heaven, and one dey sit on di throne.
Di one wey sit dey look like jasper stone and sardius; and one rainbow dey round di throne, like emerald to look.
Round di throne dey 24 thrones, and for di thrones I see 24 elders dey sit, dress in white clothes, and for dem heads dey golden crowns.
Out of di throne dey come lightnings, voices and thunders. Seven lamps of fire dey burn before di throne, wey be di seven Spirits of God;
and before di throne, e be like sea of glass, like crystal; and for di middle of di throne and round di throne, four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
Di first creature like lion, di second creature like calf, di third creature get face like man, and di fourth creature like flying eagle.

Di four living creatures, each of dem get six wings, dem full of eyes round am and inside. Dem no dey rest day or night, dey talk say, “Holy, holy, holy, di Lord God, di Almighty, wey dey, and wey don dey, and wey dey come!”
When di living creatures give glory, honour and thanks to di one wey sit on di throne, to di one wey dey alive forever and ever,
di 24 elders go fall down before di one wey sit on di throne, and go worship di one wey dey alive forever and ever, and go throw dem crowns before di throne, dey talk say,
“You worthy, our Lord and our God, to receive di glory, di honour and di power, for you create all things, and because of your will dem exist and dem create.”
I see for di right hand of di one wey sit on di throne one scroll wey dem write inside and outside, seal with seven seals.
I see one strong angel dey proclaim with loud voice, “Who worthy to open di scroll and loose im seals?”
Nobody for heaven, or for di earth, or under di earth, fit open di scroll or look am.
I cry plenty, because dem no find anybody worthy to open di scroll or to look am.
One of di elders talk to me, “No cry. Look, di Lion wey dey from di tribe of Judah, di Root of David, don overcome to open di scroll and im seven seals.”

I see for di middle of di throne and of di four living creatures, and for di middle of di elders, one Lamb dey stand, like e don dey killed, wey get seven horns and seven eyes, wey be di seven Spirits of God, wey dem send go out into all di earth.
E come and take di scroll from di right hand of di one wey sit on di throne.
When e take di scroll, di four living creatures and di 24 elders fall down before di Lamb, each one get harp and golden bowls full of incense, wey be di prayers of di holy people.
Dem sing new song, dey talk say, “You worthy to take di scroll and to open im seals, for dem kill you, and you buy people for God with your blood, from every tribe, language, people and nation,
and you don make dem kingdom and priests to our God, and dem go reign on di earth.”
I look, and I hear voice of many angels round di throne, di living creatures and di elders; and dem number na 10,000 times 10,000, and thousands of thousands,
dey talk with loud voice, “Di Lamb wey dem kill worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honour, glory and blessing!”

I hear every creature wey dey heaven, on di earth, under di earth, and on di sea, and all wey dey inside dem, dey talk say, “To di one wey sit on di throne, and to di Lamb, be blessing, honour, glory and power forever and ever!”
Di four living creatures talk say, “Amen!” and di elders fall down and worship.
I see when di Lamb open one of di seven seals, and I hear one of di four living creatures dey talk, like voice of thunder, “Come!”
I look, and look, one white horse, and di one wey dey sit on am get bow; and dem give am crown, and e go out as conqueror, and to conquer.
When e open di second seal, I hear di second living creature talk say, “Come!”
Another horse come out, red; and to di one wey dey sit on am, dem give am power to take peace from di earth, and make people kill each other; and dem give am big sword.
When e open di third seal, I hear di third living creature talk say, “Come!” I look, and look, black horse, and di one wey dey sit on am get balance for im hand.

I hear something like voice inside di middle of di four living creatures talk say, “One measure of wheat for one denarius, and three measures of barley for one denarius; and no harm di oil and di wine.”
When e open di fourth seal, I hear di voice of di fourth living creature talk say, “Come!”

I look, and look, one pale horse, and di name of di one wey dey sit on top am na Death, and Hades dey follow am. Dem give dem authority over di fourth part of di earth, to kill with sword, with famine, with death, and with di wild animals of di earth.
When e open di fifth seal, I see under di altar di souls of dem wey dem kill because of God word, and because of di testimony wey dem hold.
Dem cry with loud voice, dey talk say, “How long, Lord, di holy and true, you go wait before you judge and avenge our blood on dem wey dey dwell on di earth?”
Dem give each one white robe, and dem tell dem say make dem rest small more time, until dem fellow servants and dem brothers, wey go dey killed as dem dey killed, go complete.
I see when e open di sixth seal, and big earthquake happen; di sun turn black like sackcloth of hair, and di whole moon turn like blood;
and di stars of heaven fall to di earth, like fig tree wey dey throw down im unripe figs when strong wind shake am.
Di sky go away like scroll wey dem roll up, and every mountain and island move from dem place.
Di kings of di earth, di princes, di commanders, di rich, di strong, and every slave and free man hide dem own selves inside di caves and among di rocks of di mountains;
and dem talk to di mountains and to di rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from di face of di one wey sit on di throne, and from di wrath of di Lamb;
for di great day of im wrath don come, and who fit stand?”
After dis things I see four angels dey stand for di four corners of di earth, dey hold di four winds of di earth, so that no wind go blow on di earth, or on di sea, or on any tree.
I see another angel dey go up from di sunrise, wey get di seal of di living God. E cry with loud voice to di four angels wey dem give power to harm di earth and di sea,
talk say, “No harm di earth, di sea, or di trees, until we don seal di servants of our God on dem foreheads.”
I hear di number of dem wey dem seal: 144,000, sealed from every tribe of Israel pikin dem:
from di tribe of Judah 12,000 sealed; from di tribe of Reuben 12,000; from di tribe of Gad 12,000;
from di tribe of Asher 12,000; from di tribe of Naphtali 12,000; from di tribe of Manasseh 12,000;
from di tribe of Simeon 12,000; from di tribe of Levi 12,000; from di tribe of Issachar 12,000;
from di tribe of Zebulun 12,000; from di tribe of Joseph 12,000; from di tribe of Benjamin 12,000 sealed.

After dis I look, and look, one great crowd, wey nobody fit count, from every nation, tribes, peoples and languages, dey stand before di throne and before di Lamb, dress in white robes, with palm branches for dem hands;
and dem dey cry with loud voice, dey talk say, “Salvation belong to our God wey sit on di throne, and to di Lamb!”
All di angels dey stand round di throne, and di elders and di four living creatures; dem fall on dem faces before di throne and worship God,
dey talk say, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honour, power and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen.”
One of di elders answer me, talk say, “Dis people wey dress in white robes, who be dem, and wia dem come from?”
I talk to am say, “My oga, you know.” E talk to me say, “Dis na dem wey come out of di great suffering, and dem don wash dem robes and make dem white inside di blood of di Lamb.
Because of dis, dem dey before God throne, and dey serve am day and night inside im temple; and di one wey sit on di throne go spread im tent over dem.
Dem no go hungry again, and dem no go thirsty again; and di sun no go beat dem, or any heat;
for di Lamb wey dey di middle of di throne go shepherd dem, and go lead dem to springs of living water. And God go wipe away every tear from dem eyes.”
When e open di seventh seal, silence dey inside heaven for about half hour.
I see di seven angels wey dey stand before God, and dem give dem seven trumpets.
Another angel come and stand for di altar, wey get golden censer; and dem give am plenty incense, so that e go add am to di prayers of all di holy people on di golden altar wey dey before di throne.
Di smoke of di incense, with di prayers of di holy people, go up before God from di angel hand.
Di angel take di censer, and fill am with fire from di altar, and throw am to di earth; and thunders, voices, lightnings and earthquake happen.
Di seven angels wey get di seven trumpets prepare dem own selves to sound.
Di first angel sound, and hail and fire mix with blood come, and dem throw am to di earth; and di third part of di earth burn up, and di third part of di trees burn up, and all green grass burn up.
Di second angel sound, and something like big mountain wey dey burn with fire dem throw am enter di sea; and di third part of di sea turn blood;
and di third part of di creatures wey dey inside di sea, wey get life, die; and di third part of di ships destroy.
Di third angel sound, and big star fall from heaven, dey burn like lamp, and e fall on di third part of di rivers, and on di springs of waters.
Di name of di star na Wormwood. Di third part of di waters turn wormwood, and plenty people die from di waters, because dem turn bitter.

Di fourth angel sound, and dem strike di third part of di sun, and di third part of di moon, and di third part of di stars, so that di third part of dem go dark, and di day no go shine for di third part of am, and di night too.

I look, and I hear one eagle dey fly inside di middle of heaven, dey talk with loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to dem wey dey dwell on di earth, because of di remaining voices of di trumpets of di three angels wey go sound!”
Di fifth angel sound, and I see one star wey don fall from heaven to di earth. Dem give am di key of di pit of di abyss.
E open di pit of di abyss, and smoke come up from di pit like smoke of big furnace; and di sun and di air dark because of di smoke of di pit.
Out of di smoke locusts come out enter di earth, and dem give dem power, like di power wey scorpions of di earth get.
Dem tell dem say make dem no harm di grass of di earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only di people wey no get God seal on dem foreheads.
Dem give dem permission, no to kill dem, but to torment dem for five months; and dem torment na like di torment of scorpion, when e sting person.
For dem days, people go look for death, and dem no go find am; and dem go desire to die, and death go run from dem.
Di locusts dey look like horses wey dem prepare for battle; and for dem heads na like golden crowns, and dem faces like faces of men.
Dem get hair like women hair, and dem teeth like teeth of lions.
Dem get chests like iron breastplates; and di sound of dem wings like sound of chariots, of many horses wey dey run to battle.
Dem get tails like scorpions, and stings; and inside dem tails na dem power dey to harm people for five months.
Dem get as king over dem di angel of di abyss. Im name for Hebrew na Abaddon, and for Greek im name na Apollyon.
Di first woe don pass. Look, two more woes dey come after dis.
Di sixth angel sound, and I hear one voice from di four horns of di golden altar wey dey before God,
talk to di sixth angel wey get di trumpet, “Loose di four angels wey dem don tie for di great river Euphrates.”
Di four angels wey dem don prepare for di hour, day, month and year loose, so that dem go kill di third part of men.
Di number of di armies of di horsemen na 200,000,000; I hear dem number.

Na so I see di horses inside di vision, and dem wey dey sit on dem, wey get breastplates of fire, hyacinth and sulphur; and di heads of di horses like heads of lions; and out of dem mouths fire, smoke and sulphur dey come out.
By dis three plagues di third part of men die, by di fire, di smoke and di sulphur wey dey come out of dem mouths.
For di power of di horses dey inside dem mouths and inside dem tails; for dem tails like snakes, and dem get heads, and with dem dem dey harm.

Di rest of di people, wey no die by dis plagues, no repent of di works of dem hands, so that dem no go worship evil spirits, and idols of gold, silver, brass, stone and wood, wey no fit see, hear or walk.
Dem no repent of dem murders, or dem sorceries, or dem sexual immorality, or dem thefts.
I see another strong angel dey come down from heaven, dress with cloud; and one rainbow dey on im head, and im face like di sun, and im feet like pillars of fire;
and e get inside im hand small scroll wey dem open. E put im right foot on di sea, and im left on di land;
and e cry with loud voice, like when lion roar; and when e cry, di seven thunders talk with dem voices.
When di seven thunders talk, I wan write; and I hear voice from heaven talk say, “Seal up di things wey di seven thunders talk, and no write dem.”
Di angel wey I see dey stand on di sea and on di land lift up im right hand to heaven,

and swear by di one wey dey alive forever and ever, wey create heaven and di things wey dey inside am, di earth and di things wey dey inside am, and di sea and di things wey dey inside am, say time no go dey again;
but for di days of di voice of di seventh angel, when e go sound, God mystery go complete, as e declare to im servants di prophets.
Di voice wey I hear from heaven talk to me again, talk say, “Go, take di little scroll wey dem open inside di hand of di angel wey dey stand on di sea and on di land.”
I go to di angel, tell am make e give me di little scroll. E talk to me say, “Take am, and chop am. E go make your stomach bitter, but inside your mouth e go sweet like honey.”
I take di little scroll out of di angel hand, and chop am; and e sweet inside my mouth like honey; and when I chop am, my stomach turn bitter.
Dem talk to me say, “You must prophesy again about plenty peoples, nations, languages and kings.”
